title: Define trust tier and channel policy
purpose: Define trust tiers and channels for AgentOS artifacts before any public or verified ecosystem work.
scope: Define core, verified, organization, community and local-dev trust tiers.
Define stable, beta, edge and local channels.
Define production defaults and blocked promotions.
acceptance_criteria: Unsigned artifacts are blocked in production.
Community/local-dev artifacts are not production-promotable by default.
verification: Check trust policy references all five tiers.
failure_modes: Trust tier is implied by registry URL only.
